card.stem: A wood-burning stove combined with a solar collector is to provide central heating AND hot water for a three-bedroom, two-storey dwelling house. The design must show two independently controlled heating zones, one on each floor, with three radiators on EACH floor, control-valve locations and typical pipe sizes. The solar collector is for water heating (solar thermal). Part (c) asks for two design considerations when selecting locations for BOTH the chimney and the hot press, using notes and freehand sketches and justifying the choices.
card.questionText: Using notes and a single-line diagram, show a typical layout for BOTH central heating and domestic hot water, supplied by the wood-burning stove combined with the solar collector. Show two independently controlled heating zones, one per floor, and three radiators on each floor. Locate control valves and give typical pipe sizes.

rows.contextNote: Award the best NINE acceptable system details, each sketch 3 plus annotation 1, capped at 36. The source menu includes stove; radiator flow/return; radiators; zone valves and thermostats; header/expansion/storage tank and feeds; expansion pipe/vessel; primary flow/return; pump/valves; solar collector, flow/return and pump; twin-coil cylinder; control panel; expansion and temperature-reducing vessels. Preserve both heat sources, two independently controlled zones and six radiators. For the optional pump/valves criterion, any two applicable radiator/isolating/drain-off components satisfy that ONE detail; do not award an extra 4 marks per item. Notes on the source diagram identify zone thermostats T1/T2 although the drawn labels repeat T2; retain two independent controls.

Two appropriate labelled pipe sizes at 2 marks each. Published examples: 22 mm flow/return, 15 mm upstands and 28 mm expansion. The 300-litre twin-coil cylinder and 230-litre cold-water store are capacities, NOT pipe diameters, and do not earn these pipe-size marks. Suitable alternative coherent system sizes are accepted; this is not a closed choose-two pool of three fixed answers.

card.questionText: Using notes and freehand sketches, show a preferred location for the solar collector that will ensure its maximum efficiency in the specified water-heating system.

rows.contextNote: Explain a suitable unshaded location, normally facing south, with a coherent roof/ground/wall placement and appropriate tilt. The 2015 scheme gives a 45° optimum tilt and approximately 15° east/west tolerance as examples. Avoid chimney/tree shade and consider roof support, insulation and overheating. Its PV domestic-electricity statistic is unrelated to the required solar-thermal water-heating answer; do not substitute photovoltaic electricity generation.

Show the preferred location with a freehand sketch: collector orientation and an appropriate inclined installation, unobstructed sunlight and its relationship to the building. Keep the complete source orientation and tilt illustrations available. The awkward source phrase inclined to horizontal means an inclination relative to the horizontal, not a requirement to lay the collector flat.
